story.title: EU Leaders Convene in Finland to Discuss Arctic Policy Amid Security Concerns
story.summary: European leaders are gathering in Finland to address key issues related to the Arctic, including shipping routes, resource management, and security challenges posed by the increasing presence of Russia. The meeting comes as the region becomes more accessible due to melting ice, raising concerns about geopolitical tensions involving the US, China, and Russia.

related_stories.title: Gulf States Cancel Meeting with Iran Amid Houthi Attacks and Rising Tensions
related_stories.summary: Persian Gulf states have called off a planned meeting with Iran due to escalating tensions following new Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia. The Houthis, backed by Iran, have intensified their offensive, prompting Saudi Arabia to express anger towards Tehran and seek additional military support from the United States. The situation has raised concerns over global oil supplies and the stability of the region.

related_stories.title: Houthis Expand Control in Yemen, Displacing Thousands Amid Ongoing Conflict
related_stories.summary: The Houthis have captured additional islands in the Red Sea, including parts of the Hanish archipelago, following the withdrawal of government-allied forces. This escalation has led to the displacement of over 80,000 people in just two weeks of fighting. In response to the conflict, more than 2,000 Yemenis have fled to Djibouti, fearing a resurgence of civil war.

related_stories.title: EU and Ukraine Condemn Russian Drone Attack on Train Near Polish Border
related_stories.summary: A Russian drone attack targeted a Warsaw-bound train near Ukraine's border with Poland, shortly after it had been used by foreign dignitaries. The EU's foreign policy chief, Kaja Kallas, stated that the strike was intended to intimidate Western nations supporting Ukraine. Both Poland and Ukraine have condemned the attack as an escalation in hostilities.
